bio: La Traverse is the quintessence of a contemporary brasserie, sporting a warm, welcoming interior and a menu that mingles Flemish classics with more up-to-date dishes, of which shrimp fritters and braised pork cheeks or dimsum and cauliflower steak are just a few examples. We recommend the matured beef, cooked to perfection in a Josper oven. On Saturday evenings, La Traverse offers a menu of varied dishes to share and a platter of cured meats to nibble on....
